features.name: profitability_composite
features.description: Average of three Return on Assets (ROA) metrics to provide a stable, smoothed profitability signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a robust, continuous measure of overall asset profitability, reducing noise from individual ROA components and creating a strong linear margin.

features.name: debt_burden_index
features.description: Ratio of debt percentage to net worth percentage, indicating the relative weight of debt against equity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the severity of leverage in a continuous ratio, which is highly informative for linear models assessing financial stability.

features.name: liquidity_stress_ratio
features.description: Ratio of current liabilities to current assets, representing short-term liquidity pressure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights potential short-term cash flow issues through a direct ratio, allowing the SVM to separate highly stressed entities.

features.name: cash_flow_adequacy
features.description: Product of cash flow to total assets and cash flow to liability, emphasizing strong cash generation relative to both size and obligations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a non-linear interaction term (product) that acts as a single continuous feature for the linear model, rewarding companies with robust cash flows.

features.name: operational_efficiency_score
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the company's efficiency in utilizing assets and managing inventory/receivables based on turnover rates.
features.expected_model_benefit: Synthesizes multiple high-variance turnover metrics into a stable, bounded score suitable for linear scaling.

features.name: retained_earnings_health
features.description: Difference between retained earnings ratio and total expense ratio, indicating the net accumulation of wealth relative to ongoing costs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linear projection of long-term financial health versus short-term expenditure drag.

features.name: financial_leverage_risk
features.description: Assesses the risk associated with the company's capital structure, considering long-term liability, equity, and borrowing dependency.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates complex capital structure interactions into a single continuous risk severity measure.

features.name: net_income_margin_proxy
features.description: Approximation of net income margin by dividing net income to assets by total asset turnover, clipped to prevent extreme outliers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reconstructs a fundamental financial ratio (margin) from available normalized components, providing a strong linear predictor.

features.name: working_capital_stability
features.description: Product of working capital to total assets and working capital turnover rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines the volume of working capital with its velocity, offering a smoothed composite feature for the SVM.

features.name: growth_sustainability_metric
features.description: Evaluates the sustainability of the company's growth by analyzing asset growth, profit growth, and cash reinvestment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a qualitative assessment of whether reported growth is backed by cash and sustainable practices, reducing the impact of purely accounting-driven growth.

features.name: interest_coverage_margin
features.description: Difference between interest coverage ratio and interest expense ratio.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a direct linear margin representing the buffer a company has to cover its interest obligations.

features.name: equity_buffer_ratio
features.description: Product of net worth to assets and equity to liability, representing the overall equity cushion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Amplifies the signal of strong equity positions, providing a clear continuous feature that correlates with financial resilience.
